recipes.description: Savor our protein-packed Turkey Bacon Avocado Bowl, a hearty and nutritious mix. Crispy turkey medallions, creamy avocado, and crunchy red pepper come together, seasoned just right with salt and pepper. Topped with protein-rich hard-boiled eggs, it's a balanced meal that fuels your day.
steps: Start by cooking your turkey medallions in a heated pan until they are fully cooked and golden brown. Set them aside to cool.

While the turkey is cooking, hard-boil your eggs. Place them in a pot of water, bring it to a boil, and then let them cook for about 9-12 minutes. Once they're done, remove from heat, drain the water and let them cool before peeling. I suggest immersing them in a bowl of cold water
Chop your red pepper and avocado into bite-sized pieces. Slice your cooled turkey medallions and hard-boiled eggs.
Assemble your bowl. Begin with a layer of turkey medallions, followed by a sprinkle of chopped red pepper. Add a layer of avocado and then top with slices of hard-boiled eggs.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

recipes.description: A delicious, protein-packed meal that brings together the comforting flavors of fresh eggs, potatoes, and cheddar cheese, with the nutrition-rich goodness of broccoli and peas. Perfect for any meal of the day, this frittata is a celebration of simple ingredients transformed into a delightful dish.

ingredients.name: Broccoli
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 10.5oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Baby Potatoes
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 9.1oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Frozen Peas
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 5.3oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: 1/2 Fat Cheddar Cheese
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 2.4oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Slice the baby potatoes into coin-thickness rounds, leaving the skin on (remove if desired). Boil until nearly tender.
Use your microwave to defrost the broccoli and peas. Drain any excess water and set aside. If using fresh, steam the broccoli until tender.
Set your oven to 170 ℃ (338°F).
Once the potatoes are nearly tender, drain and transfer them to a frying pan with a touch of olive oil. Fry until the potatoes start to turn golden, then add the broccoli and peas.
In a large mixing bowl, crack the eggs, season with salt and pepper, and whisk until well combined. Stir in the grated cheddar cheese.
Pour the egg mixture over the potatoes, broccoli, and peas in the pan. Cook over low heat on the stovetop for about 4 minutes.
Transfer the pan to your preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the frittata is set.

recipes.description: A protein-packed twist on classic scrambled eggs. It's loaded with vitamins from fresh veggies and enriched with eggs and cheese. The dish gets a flavorful kick from sesame oil, soy sauce, and red chili. A tasty, nutritious way to kickstart your day!

ingredients.name: 1/2 Fat Cheddar Cheese
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 0.3 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Start by heating sesame oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped spring onion (save some for garnish), white mushrooms (sliced), cherry tomatoes (quartered), and spinach. Sauté the vegetables until they are soft and slightly caramelized.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir to mix it with the vegetables.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs until well-beaten. Pour the beaten eggs into the pan with the veggies.
Let the eggs cook for a minute until they start to set around the edges. Stir the eggs and vegetables to scramble, and continue to cook until the eggs are done to your preference.
Sprinkle the cheese over the scramble and let it melt from the residual heat.
Transfer to a plate, and garnish with the remaining spring onion and red chilli. Serve immediately while hot, and enjoy your nutritious breakfast!

recipes.description: A nutritious, low-carb delight that pairs a smooth avocado-cottage cheese blend with perfectly poached eggs. Brightened with lemon and chili flakes, and finished with microgreens and tomatoes, it's a symphony of fresh, creamy, and zesty flavors for a healthful indulgence.

ingredients.name: Low Fat Cottage Cheese
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 2.8oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.note: lemon

steps: In a food processor, combine the avocado, low-fat cottage cheese, and the juice of half a lemon. Blend until you achieve a smooth, creamy consistency. This will be the base of your dish.
Cut the large tomato in half and place it on a heated grill, cut side down. Grill until it's charred to your liking, then set aside.

Bring a pot of water to a gentle simmer. Crack one egg into a small bowl, then carefully slide it into the simmering water. Repeat with the second egg. Cook for about 4 minutes for a runny yolk, then remove with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towel.
Spread the creamy avocado mixture onto your serving plate. Arrange the poached eggs and grilled tomato halves on top.
Scatter microgreens and cherry tomatoes around the eggs and tomato, providing a fresh, colorful contrast.
To finish, sprinkle with chilli flakes and freshly ground black pepper, adjusting to taste.

recipes.description: Enjoy our "Tomato Rocket Omelette", a vibrant and flavorful breakfast option. With chicken eggs, sweet cherry tomatoes, and peppery rocket leaves, this omelette bursts with freshness and taste. Cooked to perfection and served with a side of tossed greens, it's a nutritious and delicious way to kick-start your day.
steps: Place a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a teaspoon of olive oil.
Crack the chicken eggs into a bowl and whisk them using a fork until well beaten. Season with sea salt and black pepper.
Pour the beaten eggs into the heated pan, spreading them evenly across the surface. Cook the omelette for a few minutes until the edges are set and the center is still slightly runny.
Gently fold one side of the omelette over the other, creating a half-moon shape. Slide the omelette onto a plate and serve immediately. Serve with the rocket and freshly quartered chopped tomatoes

recipes.description: This Huevos Rancheros recipe offers a hearty and flavorful twist to the classic Mexican breakfast. Combining spicy smoked chorizo, tender baby potatoes, and fresh eggs, it's a perfect blend of textures and flavors. Topped with the freshness of spring onions and a hint of smoked paprika, this dish is not only delicious but also visually appealing.

ingredients.name: Chorizo
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 4.2 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Baby Potato
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 7 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Red Onion
ingredients.note: medium

ingredients.name: Chilli
ingredients.note: red or green deseeded

steps: Start by preparing the potatoes. Cube them and boil in salted water until tender. Drain and set aside.

In a large non-stick sauté pan, add the sliced chorizo, red onion, and green chili. Cook over medium-low heat for 6-8 minutes, stirring occasionally. The chorizo will release its oils, flavoring the onion and chili.
Once the chorizo has rendered its fat and the onions are soft, add the boiled potatoes to the pan. Increase the heat to medium and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until the potatoes turn golden brown.

Carefully crack the eggs into the pan, spacing them evenly among the chorizo and potatoes. Lower the heat and let the eggs cook gently for about 4 minutes, or until they reach your desired level of doneness. Alternatively, you can finish cooking the eggs under a preheated grill on medium setting, ensuring the chorizo and potato mixture is evenly spread out in the pan.
Once the eggs are cooked to your liking, remove the pan from the heat. Sprinkle the dish with the sliced spring onions and a pinch of smoked paprika for added color and a smoky flavor.

recipes.description: A simple yet elegant dish. Tender asparagus spears provide a nutritious base for perfectly poached eggs. Sprinkled with crumbled feta cheese and garnished with fresh parsley, this recipe is a delightful combination of flavors and textures. Enjoy the protein-rich eggs and vibrant asparagus in this light and satisfying dish.

ingredients.name: Light Feta
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Trim the woody ends of the asparagus spears. Steam or boil the asparagus until tender but still crisp. Drain and set aside.

Fill a saucepan with water and bring it to a gentle simmer. Crack the eggs, one at a time, into a small bowl or ramekin. Create a gentle whirlpool in the simmering water using a spoon, then carefully slide each egg into the center of the whirlpool. Poach the eggs for about 3-4 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft and runny. Remove the eggs with a slotted spoon and place them on a paper towel to drain excess water.
Place the cooked asparagus spears on a serving plate, creating a bed for the poached eggs. Gently place the poached eggs on top of the asparagus spears.
Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese over the eggs, allowing it to melt slightly. Garnish with fresh parsley for added freshness and flavor.

steps: Crack 3 eggs into a bowl and whisk them until well beaten. Stir in 1 tablespoon of ricotta cheese into the beaten eggs, ensuring it is evenly incorporated.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add 1 teaspoon of olive oil. Allow the oil to heat up.
Pour the egg and ricotta mixture into the heated pan. Let it cook undisturbed for a moment until the edges start to set.

Using a spatula or wooden spoon, gently scramble the eggs, moving them around the pan in a circular motion. Continue cooking and stirring until the eggs are softly scrambled and cooked to your desired consistency.
Season the scrambled eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper to taste. Adjust the seasoning according to your preference.
Transfer the ricotta scrambled eggs to a plate and garnish with microgreens for added freshness and visual appeal. Enjoy while warm and creamy.

recipes.description: Transform your morning routine with a hearty and flavorful twist on a classic breakfast. Fluffy scrambled eggs, enriched with low-fat mayo and seasoned with a blend of salt, pepper, and a dash of red pepper flakes, are piled high on a toasted slice of sourdough. Finished with a sprinkle of green onions for a fresh bite.
steps: Place the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 6-7 minutes for a soft yolk. Remove the eggs from the heat and immediately place them in a bowl of ice water to cool down quickly and stop the cooking process.

Once cooled, peel the eggs and place them in a mixing bowl. Add the low-fat mayo to the bowl. Add 1/2 the chopped spring onion Season with salt, pepper, and a sprinkle of red pepper flakes according to your taste preferences. Use a fork to mash the ingredients together until you achieve a creamy, yet slightly chunky, consistency.
While preparing the egg mixture, toast the sourdough slices until golden and crispy. Adjust the toaster settings to your preference.
Spread the egg mixture evenly over the toasted sourdough slices. Ensure the mixture is not too thick, allowing the flavors to blend well with the bread.

Sprinkle additional red pepper flakes over the top for an extra kick. Garnish with the remaining spring onion, adding a fresh, crisp finish to the dish. Serve immediately while the toast is still warm and the egg mixture is creamy.

recipes.description: Experience the vibrant flavors of the Middle East with our Shakshuka recipe. This delightful dish combines tomatoes, eggs, cumin, paprika, red pepper, courgette, garlic, and red onion. Originating from North Africa, Shakshuka has become a beloved culinary treasure enjoyed throughout the Middle East and beyond

ingredients.name: Light Feta Cheese
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Dice the red pepper, courgette, garlic, and red onion.
Heat a large pan or skillet over medium heat. Add a drizzle of olive oil. Sauté the diced red pepper, courgette, garlic, and red onion until they are softened and slightly caramelized.

Sprinkle 2 teaspoons of cumin and 2 teaspoons of paprika over the sautéed vegetables. Stir well to coat the vegetables with the spices. Allow them to cook for a minute or two to release their flavors.

Pour a tin of chopped tomatoes into the pan with the vegetables and spices. Stir everything together, ensuring the vegetables are well coated with the tomato mixture. Let it simmer for a few minutes to allow the flavors to meld together and the sauce reduces down.
Using a spoon, make small wells or indentations in the tomato mixture. Carefully crack the eggs into each well, ensuring the yolks remain intact. This will allow the eggs to poach in the sauce.
Cover the pan with a lid and let the shakshuka simmer gently for about 5-7 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired level of doneness. If you prefer firmer yolks, cook them a bit longer.

Once the eggs are cooked, remove the pan from the heat. Garnish with fresh herbs such as parsley or coriander, and crumble feta cheese over the top if desired. Serve the shakshuka directly from the pan, accompanied by crusty bread or pita for dipping.

recipes.description: Explore the rich flavors of Turkey with this delightful Turkish Eggs recipe, perfect for those seeking a low-carb option on rest or light training days. Combining the creamy texture of Greek yogurt with the luxurious taste of poached eggs and a kick of chili oil, this dish is a testament to simplicity and flavor.

ingredients.name: Greek Yoghurt
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 7oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: In a bowl, stir the Greek yogurt until smooth. Season with a pinch of salt and spread the yogurt on a serving plate, creating a well in the center.

Bring a pot of water to a simmer. Add a little vinegar (optional, to help the whites firm up). Crack each egg into a small cup, then gently pour them one at a time into the simmering water. Poach for about 3-4 minutes or until the whites are set but the yolks remain runny. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on kitchen paper.
Place a poached egg in the center of each yogurt bed. Drizzle chili oil over the eggs and around the yogurt. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Sprinkle chopped dill over the top for a fresh, herby finish. Serve immediately, enjoying the contrast of cold yogurt with warm, spicy eggs.

recipes.description: A healthier take on the classic Irish deli favorite, these Sausage Roll Bites deliver the same savory, herb-infused flavor but with a lighter twist. Using low-fat sausages and a tortilla wrap instead of traditional puff pastry, they’re perfect for anyone looking for a guilt-free alternative that still packs in protein and taste.

steps: Start by removing the skins from the sausages. If you prefer, you can also mash the sausages directly in a bowl using a fork. Stir in the dried sage, thyme, and chopped rosemary. Season with salt and mix everything together until well combined.

Spread the sausage mixture evenly across a large tortilla wrap, leaving a small gap along one edge. This gap will help seal the roll later with the beaten egg. Roll the tortilla up tightly to encase the sausage filling.
Once rolled, slice the wrap into 8-10 pieces, depending on how thick you’d like each sausage roll bite to be.
Brush each of the sausage roll bites with the beaten egg to give them a beautiful golden color when cooked. Sprinkle a few sesame seeds on top of each bite for added texture.

Preheat your air fryer to 200°C (392°F). Arrange the sausage roll bites in the air fryer basket, making sure they’re spaced slightly apart. Cook for approximately 12 minutes, or until the wraps are crispy and the sausage filling is thoroughly cooked.

recipes.description: Elevate your egg game with these Soy-Spiced Fried Eggs, a perfect balance of sweet, savory, and spicy flavors. steps: In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, water, and brown sugar until combined. Set aside.

Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the sliced red onion, spring onions, minced garlic, sesame seeds, chili flakes, and chili oil. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until the onions are caramelized and the mixture becomes fragrant.

Push the onion and garlic mixture to the edges of the pan, creating space in the center. Crack the eggs directly into the pan and cook until the whites are set but the yolks remain runny, about 2-3 minutes.

Pour the prepared soy sauce mixture around the eggs, allowing it to bubble and coat the eggs as they finish cooking. Remove the eggs and aromatics from the pan and serve immediately over rice, noodles, or toast. For extra spice, top with a dollop of chili oil.

recipes.description: Start your day with a burst of flavor. This delightful breakfast combines the creamy texture of smashed avocado mixed with the zesty freshness of lemon, spring onion, and basil, gently wrapped in a warm, toasted tortilla. The soft, ribbon-like scrambled eggs are nestled on top, with a sprinkle of crumbled feta and an optional kick!

ingredients.name: Salad Tomato
ingredients.note: medium

ingredients.name: Tortilla
ingredients.note: 6 inch

ingredients.name: Lime Juice
ingredients.note: lime

steps: In a small bowl, mash the avocado until creamy. Mix in the diced spring onion, juice of a lime, 1/4 of the finely diced red chili, and a handful of chopped basil. Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste. Set aside.

Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and pepper, and whisk until well combined. Heat a non-stick pan over low heat, pour in the egg mixture, and gently scramble. Stir slowly, pushing the eggs across the pan to form soft ribbons. Remove from heat when the eggs are still slightly underdone, as they will continue to cook in their residual heat.
Toast the tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat for about 30 seconds on each side, or until they are warm and slightly crispy.

recipes.description: These Breakfast Muffins are a perfect start to any morning, combining protein-packed ingredients in a convenient and delicious package. Featuring lean beef patties, crispy bacon, and a slice of light cheddar on a toasted English muffin, they’re great for on-the-go eating and can be prepped ahead of time for quick reheating.

ingredients.name: Lean Beef Mince
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 17.6g, extra lean. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.
ingredients.sourceText: Lean Beef Mince 500g or 17.6g, extra lean

ingredients.name: Fresh Chives
ingredients.note: chopped

steps: Mix the beef mince with onion powder, garlic powder, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Form into twelve thin patties. Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat. Cook the patties for about 4-5 minutes on each side or until fully cooked. Set aside. In the same pan, cook the bacon until crispy. Set aside.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, season with salt, pepper, and chives, then whisk together. Pour the eggs into a 6-inch baking tray and cook for 12 minutes at 180 degrees.
Slice and lightly toast the English muffins. Build each muffin by placing a beef patty and a piece of bacon on the bottom half. Top with some of the cooked eggs and a slice of cheese.

If consuming immediately, you may return the assembled muffins to the oven or pan to melt the cheese and warm through for about 2-3 minutes. For later use, allow the muffins to cool, wrap individually in foil, and freeze.

Thaw overnight in the refrigerator if frozen. Unwrap from foil and microwave each side for 1 minute, then heat in the oven at 200°C (392°F) for 5-7 minutes until the muffin is crispy and the center is hot.

Heat the chili oil in a small frying pan over medium heat. Once hot, crack the egg into the pan. Fry until the whites are set but the yolk remains runny, or cook to your liking. Gently season with a pinch of pepper if desired.

recipes.description: Start your day with the English Muffin Breakfast Delight, an easy to cook meal. This dish combines a warm, toasted English muffin with juicy air-fried sausages and a perfectly cooked egg, topped with fresh rocket and a hint of sweet and tangy apple chutney. It's a blend of flavors and textures that's sure to brighten up your morning.

ingredients.name: Sausages
ingredients.note: reduced fat

steps: Start by placing the sausages in the air fryer. Cook them according to your air fryer's instructions until they are evenly browned and fully cooked, usually taking about 10-15 minutes depending on the sausage thickness.

When the sausages are nearly cooked, prepare the egg. You can fry, scramble, or poach the egg based on your preference. For a classic touch, a sunny-side-up or a well-done fried egg works wonderfully.
Split the English muffin in half and toast it until it's nicely browned and crispy. The toasting gives it a lovely texture and warmth, enhancing the overall flavor of the sandwich.
Now, assemble your breakfast delight. Place the cooked sausages on the bottom half of the toasted English muffin. Next, carefully place the cooked egg on top of the sausages.
Add a fresh element by topping the egg with a handful of rocket. The rocket's peppery flavor will complement the richness of the egg and sausage.
Finish it off with a teaspoon of chutney spread over the top. The chutney adds a sweet and tangy flavor, creating a delightful contrast with the other components. and a wedge of lime.

recipes.description: Start your morning with a kick! This dish combines the savory delight of halloumi with a sweet and spicy glaze, perfectly complemented by creamy avocado and the richness of poached eggs. It’s a hearty breakfast packed with protein and vibrant flavors, ideal for fueling up on busy mornings or enjoying a lazy weekend brunch.

recipes.description: This high-protein, fiber-packed dish is the perfect way to start your day or refuel after a workout. The smoky black beans, crispy Parmesan crust, and perfectly cooked eggs create a harmony of bold flavors. Paired with a zesty roasted red pepper salsa, it’s a satisfying meal that’s rich in nutrients and texture.

ingredients.note: medium

steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the diced red onion and cook for 4–5 minutes with a pinch of salt until softened. Stir in the garlic, paprika, cumin, and chili powder, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add the black beans (with water) and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

Char the red pepper directly over a gas flame (or under the grill) until blistered. Finely chop the roasted red pepper, chili, and coriander. Combine in a bowl with olive oil and lime juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

In a large non-stick frying pan, sprinkle grated Parmesan in two circular piles. Heat the pan over medium heat until the cheese begins to melt and sizzle. Crack an egg on top of each Parmesan circle and cook for 4–5 minutes until the whites are set and the Parmesan is crispy. For softer whites, cover the pan with a lid during the last minute of cooking.

Serve the smoky black beans as a base. Top with the Parmesan-crusted eggs. Add a generous spoonful of roasted red pepper salsa. Garnish with lime wedges for an extra zesty kick. Optional: Serve with warm tortillas on the side for a complete meal.

steps: Set your oven to 180°C (356°F) and line a square baking dish with parchment paper.

In a bowl or jug, whisk together the whole eggs, egg whites, spinach, cherry tomatoes, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Pour into the lined baking dish and bake for 15–20 minutes, or until just set. Let it cool slightly and cut into 4 equal squares.

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees. As the oven preheats, to a large bowl add the turkey mince and seasoning. Mix well and then form into 6 thin patties.
Next, crack 6 eggs into a bowl and mix them well. Add some black pepper. Transfer the egg mixture into a small baking tray so that you can make 6 squares of the egg once cooked.

Add the egg tray into the oven and cook for 5 to 8 minutes. Check after 5 minutes to see if it is cooked fully and every minute thereafter. You may need to place it under the grill to finish off the top. Alternatively, just cook a 6-egg omelet.
As the egg cooks, add a tsp of olive oil to a large pan, cooking the turkey burgers for 4 to 5 minutes on each side.
As the turkey burgers and egg cook, toast your muffins. Then spread one triangle of cheese on the bottom half of each muffin.

Place the cooked turkey burger next, followed by a square slice of the egg mixture (or a piece of the omelet). Finally, top with a slice of cheese. Leave it to sit for 1 minute before eating to allow for the cheese to melt.
You can place the muffins in the freezer in an airtight container once cooled for easy access. Just take one out, let it defrost, and enjoy it hot or cold.

recipes.description: Fluffy, high-protein pancakes that make a perfect post-workout meal or a weekend breakfast treat. These Protein Pancakes with Peanut Butter Cream offer a balance of slow-release carbs, quality protein, and healthy fats — ideal for muscle recovery or simply fueling your day. Quick to prepare, light to eat, and deliciously satisfying!

steps: In a small bowl, combine the Greek yoghurt and peanut butter. Mix until smooth and creamy. Set aside.

In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sweetener, baking powder, vanilla whey, and a pinch of salt. In a separate jug, whisk the milk and egg together. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and whisk until a smooth batter forms.

Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add a splash of olive oil and swirl to coat. Once hot, drop heaped spoonfuls of batter into the pan to form small pancakes. Cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface, then flip and cook for another 1–2 minutes until golden and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter, keeping cooked pancakes warm.
Stack the pancakes and top generously with the peanut butter cream. Optionally, drizzle with 0-calorie syrup for extra sweetness.

steps: Place the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and let simmer for 7-8 minutes for soft-boiled eggs or 9-10 minutes for firmer yolks. Transfer to an ice bath for a couple of minutes, then peel the eggs.

recipes.description: This creamy, dreamy bowl of oats is infused with coconut, topped with fresh mango, and finished with a silky coconut drizzle. It’s a nourishing, tropical-inspired breakfast that feels indulgent while delivering plenty of fibre, healthy fats, and protein. A perfect way to start the day — or treat yourself to a cozy evening bowl.

ingredients.note: Original reference: or 5fl oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: In a small saucepan, whisk together the 100 ml light coconut milk, 1 tsp honey, and 1 tsp cornstarch. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, then reduce to a simmer. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Remove from heat and set aside.
In a bowl, combine 45 g oats, 150 ml hot water, 1 tsp flaxseeds, and a pinch of salt. Let it sit for 10 minutes to soften.

Transfer the softened oats to a pot. Add 100 ml light coconut milk and cook over medium heat. Once it starts bubbling, reduce to a simmer and cook until thickened to your liking, stirring often. Stir in 1 scoop of vanilla whey during the last minute of cooking. If the mixture gets too thick, add a splash of extra coconut milk to loosen.
Spoon the oats into a bowl, top with sliced fresh mango, and drizzle generously with the coconut sauce.
Sprinkle with white sesame seeds and desiccated coconut for extra crunch and flavour.

With a crunchy granola base and no added fat, they’re the perfect balance of indulgence and nourishment — ideal as a post-dinner dessert or a high-protein snack.

steps: Add the granola to a blender and pulse until you achieve a fine, crumb-like texture. Divide evenly between small ramekins or dessert jars and lightly press down to form a base.

In a food processor, combine the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, lime juice, honey, and lime zest. Blend for 12–15 seconds or until smooth and creamy. Avoid over-processing, as this can make the mixture watery.
Spoon the creamy filling on top of the granola base, smoothing the tops with a spoon or spatula.
For a firmer texture, refrigerate the pots for 30 minutes before serving. Otherwise, they’re ready to enjoy immediately.
Garnish with extra lime zest or a slice of lime if desired.

recipes.description: Start your day with a delightful twist on the classic banoffee pie, transformed into a nutritious breakfast pot. Layers of crunchy Weetabix soaked in your choice of milk, topped with a homemade date and banana caramel, fresh banana slices, and creamy vanilla protein yogurt.

ingredients.note: Original reference: or 5.3oz, 0% fat. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Banana
ingredients.note: small

ingredients.name: Dates
ingredients.note: khalas dates, pitted

ingredients.name: Whey Protein
ingredients.note: vanilla

steps: Crumble the two Weetabix into your serving container. Gently pour the milk over the crumbled Weetabix, pressing them down slightly to form a compact base.

Submerge the dates in boiling water mixed with bicarbonate of soda and leave them to soak for 5 minutes. Drain the dates and blend them with half a banana. Gradually loosen the mixture with warm water, adding one tablespoon at a time, until you achieve a smooth caramel consistency similar to thick honey.
Spread a heaped tablespoon of the date caramel over the Weetabix base. Layer slices of banana on top of the caramel. Spoon the vanilla protein yogurt over the banana slices.
Dust a little cocoa powder over the top for a hint of chocolate flavor. Enjoy immediately for the best texture or refrigerate and consume within 2 days for a chilled treat.

Protein-packed and infused with the warming spice of cinnamon, it's a nutritious way to start your day or enjoy as a guilt-free treat.

steps: Start by heating your oven to 180°C (356°F).
In a blender, combine the rolled oats, protein powder, ripe banana, baking powder, cinnamon, and water. Blend everything until the mixture is smooth and uniform.
Take a skillet or a small baking dish and coat lightly with non-stick spray to prevent sticking. Carefully pour the blended oat mixture into the dish, ensuring it's spread out evenly.
Scatter the frozen raspberries over the top of the oat mixture, pressing them down lightly into the surface.
Transfer the skillet or baking dish to the oven and bake for 18-20 minutes, or until the oats are set and the top is golden brown.

Once baked, remove the dish from the oven. Melt the white chocolate spread slightly if it’s not already soft, then drizzle over the top of the baked oats. Allow the baked oats to cool for a few moments, then dive in and enjoy the warm, fruity, and indulgent flavors!

recipes.description: Elevate the classic beans on toast with this spicy and tangy version. Sautéed onions, garlic, and mushrooms form a flavorful base while the mix of paprika and chili flakes brings the heat. Served with creamy avocado, every bite is a delightful medley of tastes and textures. Serve it over crunchy sourdough for the ultimate breakfast.

ingredients.name: White Mushrooms
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 4.2 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Dice 1/2 an onion and chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the tin of mixed beans. Slice the mushrooms.
In a pan over medium heat, add some oil and sauté the onion until translucent. Add the chopped garlic, 1/4 tsp chili flakes, and 1 tsp paprika. Stir and cook for another 2 minutes until aromatic.
Optional step, otherwise add them as is: In a blender, combine the tin of chopped tomatoes, 1 tbsp soy sauce, and 3 tbsp apple cider vinegar. Blend until smooth.

Add the sliced mushrooms to the pan and sauté until they release their moisture and become golden brown. Reduce the heat to low, pour in the blended tomato mixture, and add 2 tbsp brown sugar. Stir well. Add the drained mixed beans to the pan. Let the mixture simmer, stirring occasionally until it thickens to your liking.
While the beans are cooking, halve and pit the avocado. Scoop out the flesh and slice it using a knife. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Toast the 4 slices of sourdough bread. Top with the spicy bean mixture and serve with the avocado.

recipes.description: A wholesome and delicious treat packed with nutritious ingredients. It combines the creamy texture of chia seeds soaked in almond milk and Skyr yogurt, sweetened subtly with honey. The indulgent topping of vibrant, freshly pureed strawberries and blackberries adds a burst of fruity delight. T

ingredients.name: Almond Milk
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 6.7 fl oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Protein Yogurt

steps: In a medium-sized bowl, combine 200ml of unsweetened almond milk, 50g of Skyr yogurt, 3 tablespoons of chia seeds, and 1 level teaspoon of honey. Mix well until the honey is dissolved and the chia seeds are evenly distributed throughout the mixture.
Wash 5 strawberries and 5 raw blackberries, then pat dry. Puree the strawberries and blackberries until smooth.
Spoon the chia mixture into a seal-tight jar. Pour the berry puree over the top, creating a layered effect.
Seal the jar tightly and place it in the refrigerator. Allow the chia pudding to set overnight.

recipes.description: A medley of silky oats steeped in almond milk, punctuated with chia seeds for an added nutritional boost. The caramelized blueberries with a hint of maple syrup lend a sweet-tart contrast, while flaked almonds offer a delightful crunch. Rounded off with creamy yogurt, every spoonful is a delightful dance of flavors.

ingredients.name: Almond Milk
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 3.4 oz, unsweetened. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Porridge Oats
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1.7 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: In a bowl, combine the oats, chia seeds, a pinch of salt, and vanilla extract. Pour in the almond milk, stirring well to ensure all ingredients meld together.
Cover the mixture and place it in the refrigerator to soak overnight, allowing the oats and chia seeds to swell and absorb the flavors.
The next morning, in a pan over medium heat, fry the blueberries with a drizzle of maple syrup until they turn slightly soft and the syrup thickens.
Take out your overnight oats from the fridge and give it a good stir. If the mixture is too thick, add a splash more almond milk for your preferred consistency.
Transfer the soaked oats to your serving dish. Spoon over the caramelized blueberries, followed by a dollop of yogurt.
Finish with a sprinkle of flaked almonds on top.

recipes.description: This high-protein, healthy fat-packed breakfast is perfect for fueling your morning or post-workout recovery. With boiled eggs for protein, avocado for heart-healthy fats, and rocket for a boost of vitamins, this meal keeps you satisfied and energized.

ingredients.name: Light Soft Cheese

steps: Place the eggs in a saucepan and cover with cold water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and let simmer for 7-9 minutes for a firm yolk. Once done, drain and transfer the eggs to an ice bath for a few minutes before peeling.
In a small bowl, mash the avocado with the cream cheese until smooth. Season with a pinch of salt & pepper to taste.

Spread the avocado cream cheese mixture evenly on a plate. Slice the boiled eggs and place them on top. Sprinkle with another pinch of salt & pepper. Top with a handful of fresh rocket leaves for extra flavor and crunch. Enjoy immediately!

steps: In a small mixing bowl, combine the soy or Greek yogurt, oats, and golden raisins.

Once mixed well, cover the bowl with a lid or plastic wrap. Place the bowl in the refrigerator and allow it to sit overnight. This resting period lets the oats soak up the yogurt, making them creamy and soft by morning.
The next day, when you're ready to eat, remove the bowl from the fridge. Stir the mixture to check the consistency. Now, add the grated apple, raspberries, and banana slices to the bowl.
Drizzle the top with maple syrup for a touch of added sweetness. Finally, scatter the chopped walnuts over the top for that added crunch.

recipes.description: Elevate your breakfast or brunch with these Cheesy Potato Pancakes, featuring a perfectly crisp exterior and a heartwarming, gooey mozzarella center. These pancakes are an excellent way to turn leftover potatoes into a delightful savory treat that's both comforting and satisfying.

steps: Start by mashing the boiled potatoes in a large bowl until mostly smooth or use a ricer.
Mix in the potato starch, onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, cayenne pepper, and a generous pinch of salt and pepper. Combine thoroughly to create a homogenous pancake batter.
Place a non-stick pan over medium heat and allow it to warm up while you form the pancakes.

Divide the potato mixture into 4 equal parts. Flatten each portion into a patty, place a chunk of mozzarella in the center, and fold the edges over to encase the cheese completely. Gently flatten to form a pancake shape.

Add a small amount of oil to the pan if necessary, then place one pancake in the pan. Cook for about 4 minutes on each side or until golden brown and crispy. The cheese should be melted and gooey when done.

recipes.description: Perfect for a weekend treat or a nutritious post-workout meal, these pancakes combine the natural sweetness of sweet potatoes with the fiery zest of harissa. Accompanied by a creamy yogurt topping and a perfectly poached egg.

ingredients.name: Sweet Potato
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 10.6oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Greek Yoghurt
ingredients.note: 0% fat

steps: Squeeze out excess moisture from the grated sweet potatoes using a kitchen towel or cheese cloth. In a mixing bowl, combine the sweet potatoes with harissa, salt, pepper, mixed herbs, egg, and flour. Mix well to form a cohesive batter.
Divide the mixture into four equal portions. Form each portion into a ball, then flatten into a pancake shape.

Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Place the pancakes in the pan and cook for about 4-5 minutes on each side, or until crispy and golden brown. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain any excess oil.
Swirl a tablespoon of yogurt with a dash of harissa and spread it on the serving plates. Place two pancakes on each plate, top each with a poached egg, and sprinkle with fresh coriander.

recipes.description: Crunchy, nutty, and lightly sweetened, this Nutty Honey Granola is a perfect topping for yogurt, a quick snack, or an energizing breakfast. Packed with heart-healthy oats, mixed nuts, dried fruit, and seeds, it’s a delicious way to start your day or fuel up for your next adventure.

steps: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F).
In a large mixing bowl, combine the oats, chopped mixed nuts, mixed seeds, peanut oil, honey, and a pinch of salt. Stir until all the dry ingredients are well coated with the honey and oil.
Spread the oat mixture evenly onto a lined baking tray. Bake for 10 minutes, stirring halfway through to ensure even toasting.
Remove the granola from the oven and sprinkle the dried fruit over the top. Stir to mix the fruit in evenly.
Return the tray to the oven and bake for an additional 8 minutes, or until the granola is golden brown and fragrant.
Allow the granola to cool completely on the baking tray. It will crisp up as it cools. Once fully cooled, store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.description: A deliciously layered, oven-baked delight. This frittata is a beautiful blend of earthy squash, tangy goat cheese, and nutritious greens, all held together by fluffy, well-seasoned eggs. Perfect for a satisfying breakfast, brunch, or light dinner.

ingredients.name: Butternut Squash
ingredients.note: cubed

ingredients.name: Leek
ingredients.note: average

ingredients.name: Goats Cheese
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 2.1oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Start by preheating your oven to 190C/375F. Then begin by cubing the squash. Toss the cubed squash with olive oil, season, and roast for about 35-40 minutes until cooked. Once done, reduce the oven temperature to 170C/340F.
Meanwhile, crack the eggs into a large bowl, season with salt and pepper, and whisk together.
Lightly spray the bottom of a 10-inch frying pan with 0 Cal spray. Add the sliced leeks and sauté over low heat for about 10 minutes until they soften.
Stir in the rocket, cooking until slightly wilted.
Now, introduce the roasted squash cubes and sliced goat cheese to the pan.
Pour the whisked eggs over the ingredients in the pan, letting it cook on the stovetop over low heat for about 4 minutes.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the frittata is set and lightly browned on top.
Allow the frittata to cool a bit before dividing into six servings. Serve warm and savor the hearty blend of flavors!

recipes.description: A delightful twist on traditional pancakes that blend the richness of sweet potato with the unique texture of Swiss cheese. Perfect for a hearty breakfast or as a novel brunch item, these pancakes are infused with the fresh zest of parsley and a hint of nutmeg for a flavorful kick.

steps: If not already cooked, peel and cube the sweet potatoes, then boil until tender. Drain and allow to cool slightly.
In a blender or food processor, combine the cooked sweet potatoes, eggs, torn bread slices, parsley, red onion, and a dash of nutmeg. Blend until you achieve a smooth, thick batter.

Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Scoop a portion of the batter onto the skillet, and spread it into a pancake shape. Quickly add a few cubes of Swiss cheese in the center, then spoon a little more batter over the cheese to cover. Let it cook until the edges begin to firm up and the bottom is golden brown, about 3-4 minutes, then flip carefully and cook the other side.
Continue cooking the rest of the pancakes in the same manner. Serve the pancakes hot from the skillet, garnished with extra parsley or a dollop of sour cream if desired.

recipes.description: Savor a hearty fusion of tender sweet potato chunks seasoned with a bold BBQ spice mix, nestled within a fluffy and savory egg base. This frittata is not only a celebration of flavors but is also a visually appealing centerpiece for your table. Pair with a vibrant green salad for a complete meal that satisfies.

ingredients.note: Original reference: or 21 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Preheat your oven to 200°C/400°F/Gas 6.
Begin by parboiling the peeled and chopped sweet potatoes in a pot of boiling water for about 4-5 minutes. Drain and set aside.

In a large, preferably ovenproof-handled, non-stick pan, warm the olive oil over medium heat. Add the parboiled sweet potatoes, BBQ spice mix, and season generously with salt and pepper. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until they take on a golden hue.
Briskly whisk the eggs in a separate bowl until well combined. Season accordingly.
Pour the seasoned egg mixture over the sweet potatoes, ensuring even coverage.
Add the pan to the oven and bake for another 10–12 minutes, or until the eggs have set firmly.
Once cooked, let the frittata cool and firm up for about 5 minutes. Cut into desired wedges and serve.

On each wrap: Spread 2 tbsp of marinara sauce over the base. Sprinkle with 10g (0.35oz) grated mozzarella. Place the cooked chicken on top. Add another 1 tbsp of marinara sauce over the chicken. Top with another 10g (0.35oz) grated mozzarella and 2 fresh basil leaves.

With a fluffy centre and crisp cinnamon-sugar coating, they’re ideal for satisfying sweet cravings while still hitting your protein goals. Perfect for breakfast, snacks, or a post-workout treat!

steps: In a bowl, whisk together the egg, 20g (0.7oz) melted butter, Greek yoghurt, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the sweetener, salt, and self-raising flour. Mix until a soft, sticky dough forms. If the dough feels too wet, add up to 20g (0.7oz) more flour.
Lightly dust a plate or tray with flour. Scoop heaped tablespoons of dough onto the floured surface. Dust your hands with flour and gently roll each portion into a ball.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C (390°F) using the roast or bake setting. Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper and spray lightly with oil.

While still warm, brush with 20g (0.7oz) melted butter and roll in the cinnamon sugar mix. Alternatively, dust with icing sugar if preferred.

recipes.description: This recipe packs a punch of flavor, combining the protein-packed juicy chicken with a crispy exterior of seasoned breadcrumbs.

ingredients.name: Chicken
ingredients.note: breasts, average size

ingredients.name: Panko Breadcrumbs
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1.8oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1/2 tsp powder. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: First, dice the chicken breasts and leave them to the side.
Next, to a bowl add the 2 eggs and lightly beat them using a fork.
In a separate bowl, add the breadcrumbs. garlic cloves (crushed or use powder), paprika, and dried parsley. Mix well.

Now it is time to coat the chicken. Begin by soaking the chicken in egg before transferring to the dry mix, coating the chicken fully. Place the coated chicken in the air fryer or on a roasting tray. Cook for 15 minutes at 180 degrees celsius.

As the chicken cooks, prepare the sauces. First, in a mixing bowl, add the honey, sriracha, and tablespoon of dried parsley. Mix well and leave to the side. Next make the dipping sauce by combining a tbsp of ketchup, light mayonnaise, and sriracha hot sauce.
Once the chicken is cooked, toss the chicken bites in the sriracha honey sauce and place them back in the oven for another 10 to 15 minutes until crispy. Serve with some dipping sauce.

recipes.description: Crispy, juicy chicken breast wrapped in a soft tortilla with crunchy lettuce and a cooling sweet chilli yogurt — this easy wrap is perfect for a satisfying lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Tortilla
ingredients.note: large

ingredients.name: Corn Flakes
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 0.7oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Set your air fryer to 200°C (or oven to 220°C fan).

Crush the corn flakes into fine crumbs. In a bowl, combine with paprika, salt, and pepper. In a separate bowl, add 1 beaten egg. Dip each chicken strip into the egg mixture, followed by the cornflake mixture.
Place the coated strips in the air fryer or oven and cook for 12–15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Warm the wrap if desired. Spread yogurt and sweet chilli sauce over the base. Add the chopped lettuce, followed by the crispy chicken.
Roll the wrap tightly, slice in half, and enjoy!

recipes.description: This Crispy Chicken with Tomato Basil Sauce brings together juicy, tender chicken coated in a Parmesan breadcrumb crust with a rich, herby tomato sauce. High in protein and packed with vibrant Mediterranean flavors, it’s a lighter take on a comfort classic. Perfect for a balanced dinner that’s both satisfying and nutrient-dense.

ingredients.name: Breadcrumbs
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Parmesan Cheese
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Cherry Tomato
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 5.3oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Red Pepper
ingredients.note: medium

ingredients.name: Salt & Pepper
ingredients.note: of each

steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Sauté the diced onion, chopped red pepper, halved cherry tomatoes, crushed garlic, and chopped basil stems with a pinch of salt and pepper for 5–7 minutes until softened.
Add the sundried tomato paste, tomato purée, and balsamic vinegar. Cook for another few minutes, pressing down on the tomatoes to release their juices.
Simmer gently until thickened, adding a splash of water if needed. Stir in fresh basil leaves. Season to taste and set aside.

Mix the breadcrumbs with smoked paprika, garlic granules, and 2/3rds of the grated Parmesan. Place each chicken breast between baking parchment or cling film and gently pound to an even thickness. Season with salt and pepper. Dredge the chicken in the flour, dip into the beaten egg, and coat thoroughly with the breadcrumb mixture, pressing firmly to adhere.

Preheat the air fryer to 195°C fan (380°F). Air fry the chicken for 15–18 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden, crispy, and cooked through (internal temp should reach 75°C/165°F). Spoon the tomato basil sauce onto plates, place the crispy chicken on top, and garnish with rocket and extra Parmesan.

The white fish fillets are air-fried to golden perfection with a crunchy breadcrumb coating, while the vibrant mango salsa adds a refreshing, slightly sweet kick. Served in soft taco shells with crisp lettuce and a squeeze of lime, this high-protein, nutrient-rich meal is ideal for a quick dinner.

steps: Season the fish strips with salt and pepper. Set up a breading station: one bowl with flour, one with beaten egg, and one with breadcrumbs mixed with smoked paprika and garlic powder.

Coat each strip: first in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs. Press to coat well. Spray the air fryer basket with olive oil spray. Place breaded fish strips in a single layer and spray tops lightly with oil.
Air fry at 200°C (390°F) for 10–12 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.
Combine diced mango, red pepper, red onion, coriander, lime juice, and a pinch of salt in a bowl. Toss gently.
Warm the taco shells. Layer with shredded lettuce, crispy fish, and spoonfuls of fresh mango salsa. Finish with an optional squeeze of lime.

recipes.description: This dish is a fusion of tender, protein-rich chicken with a spicy, sweet, and savory rub and sauce. Cornflakes add an irresistible crunch, while sesame seeds offer a hint of nuttiness. Fresh coriander lifts the flavor profile, creating a well-rounded, nutritious meal.

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast
ingredients.note: average

ingredients.name: Cornflakes
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 2.8 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Cut the chicken into tenders.
In a bowl, mix onion powder, garlic powder, gochujang paste, paprika, and salt to create the rub. Coat the chicken tenders in the rub and let marinate for at least 30 minutes if you can.
While the chicken is marinating, crush the cornflakes into a coarse texture. Beat the eggs in a separate bowl.
Once marinated, dip the chicken tenders in the egg, then roll them in the crushed cornflakes. Ensure they're thoroughly coated.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C (or 350°F).
Place the chicken tenders in the air fryer and cook for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through. Ensure they are not overlapping.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the sauce. Heat the sesame oil in a pan, add finely minced garlic, soy sauce, gochujang, and brown sugar. Simmer until the sugar is dissolved.
Toss the cooked chicken tenders in the sauce until they're completely coated. Garnish with sesame seeds and fresh coriander before serving. Enjoy!

recipes.description: These crispy air-fried gyozas are a lighter, high-protein twist on traditional dumplings. Juicy prawns are blended with garlic, spring onion, and chives for a savoury filling, then wrapped in rice paper and air-fried to golden perfection. Served with a punchy soy-chilli dipping sauce, they’re ridiculously moreish and surprisingly easy to make.

ingredients.name: Prawns
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 7oz, cooked. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Finely chop the prawns, chives, and spring onions. Add them to a bowl with the oyster sauce, garlic, salt, pepper, and corn starch. Mix until well combined (you can also pulse everything in a food processor for a finer texture).
Cut each rice paper sheet in half. Submerge one half-sheet in warm water for a few seconds until just softened, then lay flat on a clean plate.
Spoon a heaped tablespoon of the filling onto the centre of the rice paper. Fold in half to form a crescent shape, then press around the edges to seal. Repeat with remaining sheets and filling.

Lightly spray both sides of the gyozas with cooking spray. Place onto baking paper in your air fryer basket. Air fry at the highest setting (Max Crisp or 200°C/392°F) for 8 minutes per side, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.

While the gyozas cook, stir together the soy sauce, sesame oil, chilli oil, and sesame seeds in a small bowl. Let the gyozas cool slightly before serving. Dip generously into the sauce and enjoy while crisp!

Packed with fragrant prawns, spring onions, and sesame, then crisped up in the air fryer—no deep frying needed. Serve with a creamy hoisin–peanut dipping sauce for the ultimate crunch and flavour combo.

steps: Blitz prawns, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, soy sauce, egg white, bread, and pepper in a food processor until smooth. or dice the prawns. Fold through the chopped spring onions.

Dip one rice paper sheet in warm water until pliable. Lay it flat on a board. Spoon ¼ of the prawn mixture along the lower third of the sheet in a cylindrical log shape. Roll tightly, tucking in the sides as you go, so it forms a neat cylinder. Repeat with remaining sheets/filling (4 rolls total).
Lightly mist each roll with oil spray. Sprinkle or roll in sesame seeds so they stick to the damp rice paper.
Place rolls seam-side down in the air fryer basket (don’t overcrowd). Air fry at 200 °C (392 °F) for 10–12 minutes, turning once, until crisp, golden, and cooked through.

recipes.description: Elevate your taco night with a delightful blend of sweet and spicy flavors that perfectly complement the delicate white fish. Ideal for a light yet satisfying meal, this recipe features a vibrant slaw and a robust marinade that transforms simple ingredients into a feast for the senses.

steps: Prepare the fish by patting it dry, seasoning with salt and pepper, and lightly dusting with flour. Thoroughly coat the fillets in the marinade mixture (1 tsp honey, harissa, paprika, cumin, tomato puree and garlic) and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes.

For the slaw, blend the yogurt, honey, jalapeño brine, jalapeños, spring onion, garlic, lime juice and zest, and mustard with a pinch of salt until smooth. Adjust seasoning as desired for more heat. Toss the dressing with the shredded cabbage and set aside to marinate.
Cook the fish in a preheated oven or air fryer at 205°C (400°F) fan for about 8-10 minutes, or until flaky and lightly golden. Optional: Finish under the grill for a charred effect.

Char the tacos on an open flame or a hot pan for added texture and flavor. Assemble the tacos with layers of fresh avocado slices, flaked fish, a generous helping of slaw, and a sprinkle of crumbled feta. Drizzle with extra lime juice if desired.

steps: In a small bowl, combine the grainy mustard, Dijon mustard, and honey. Mix until well combined.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Coat the chicken evenly with the honey mustard sauce.

Preheat your air fryer as per the manufacturer's instructions. Once preheated, place the chicken in the air fryer basket and cook until it's thoroughly cooked and golden brown. Ensure the chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear.

recipes.description: This quick meal features perfectly air-fried salmon marinated in lemon, garlic, and olive oil for a punch of flavour. It’s paired with tender asparagus spears, roasted until golden and topped with Parmesan for a salty, savoury finish. High in protein and rich in omega-3s, this is a dinner that feels indulgent, but keeps your goals in mind.

While the salmon marinates, toss the asparagus spears with 1 tsp olive oil, 2 cloves minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Prepare to cook them alongside or after the salmon.

Preheat your air fryer to 180°C (355°F). Place the salmon fillets in one air fryer basket, skin-side down, without overcrowding. Cook for 10-12 minutes, depending on the thickness of the fillets, or until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Place the asparagus in the second air fryer basket. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Air fry at 180°C (355°F) for 7-8 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.

recipes.description: Each cod fillet is marinated in a savory blend of miso paste, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil, creating layers of umami flavor. Paired with the gentle crunch of fresh pak choi and accented with fiery red chili and aromatic spring onions, this dish is a testament to the simplicity and elegance of Asian cuisine.

steps: In a bowl, whisk together the miso paste, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil until fully combined. Ensure the miso paste is well dissolved.
Coat the cod fillets thoroughly with the prepared marinade, ensuring they are well covered. Let them sit while you prepare the vegetables for a deeper infusion of flavors.

Place the halved pak choi at the bottom of the air fryer basket. Position the marinated cod fillets on top of the pak choi. This allows the fish to steam gently while infusing the pak choi with its flavors.

Drizzle the remaining marinade over the cod and pak choi. Sprinkle evenly with sliced red chili, sesame seeds, and chopped spring onions. Add a final drizzle of sesame oil and season with a touch of salt and pepper for enhanced flavor.

Set your air fryer to 200°C (392°F) and cook for approximately 10 minutes. The exact time may vary based on the thickness of the cod fillets and the model of your air fryer. The fish should be flaky and opaque, and the pak choi should be tender yet slightly crisp.

Garnished with spring onions, these tacos offer a delicious fusion of Korean flavors with a fun Mexican twist, making them a must-try for any taco night!

steps: In a small bowl, mix together Gochujang paste, honey, soy sauce, ketchup, sugar, minced ginger, and water. Set aside some of this sauce mixture for the mayo.
Season the chicken pieces with minced garlic, black pepper, soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Dip the seasoned chicken into beaten egg white, then dredge in cornflour.
Spray the chicken with a low-calorie cooking spray. Air fry at 190°C (374°F) for 6 minutes on the crisp tray, flip, and cook for another 6 minutes.
Carefully remove the crisp tray and coat the chicken with most of the Gochujang sauce, reserving some for the mayo. Return to the air fryer and cook at 200°C (392°F) for an additional 2 minutes.
Mix the reserved Gochujang sauce with light mayonnaise and 2 tbsp water to create a flavorful mayo.
Lightly toast or char the tortillas over a flame. Place a bed of shredded lettuce on each tortilla, top with the crispy Gochujang chicken, drizzle with the spicy mayo, and garnish with spring onions.

recipes.description: Juicy chicken tenders, coated in a crispy cornflake crust and seasoned with Cajun spices, are glazed with a sticky sweet chilli sauce and nestled in soft mini tortilla wraps. Fresh lettuce and diced cherry tomatoes add a refreshing crunch. An optional drizzle of low-fat yogurt adds a creamy contrast to the spicy and sweet flavors.

steps: In a small bowl, mix together the sweet chilli sauce and honey. Set this sticky glaze aside for later use.
Cut the chicken breasts into tenders, aiming for 3-4 pieces per breast. Season them with 2 tablespoons of the Cajun seasoning, along with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Place the cornflakes in a zip-lock bag and crush them into small pieces. Transfer to a bowl and mix in the remaining 2 teaspoons of Cajun seasoning for an extra flavor kick.
Whisk the egg in a separate bowl. Dip each chicken tender first into the whisked egg, ensuring it’s fully coated, and then roll it in the seasoned cornflakes. Make sure each piece is well-covered.

Arrange the coated chicken tenders in the air fryer basket. Spray them lightly with a low-calorie cooking spray. Cook at 180°C (356°F) for 6 minutes. Flip the tenders, spray again, and cook for another 6 minutes or until the chicken is thoroughly cooked. In the last 2 minutes of cooking, brush the tenders with the prepared sweet chilli and honey glaze, allowing it to caramelize slightly.

Warm the mini tortilla wraps as per the package instructions. On each wrap, lay a bed of sliced lettuce and diced cherry tomatoes. Place the glazed chicken tenders on top of the salad bed. It’s lightened up using the air fryer, but still bursting with bold umami, garlic, and five spice goodness.

In a mixing bowl, combine 1/2 tsp white pepper, 1 tsp chinese five-spice powder, garlic, ginger, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, and egg white. Add the chicken, stir to coat, and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes—or overnight in the fridge for deeper flavour.
Pour the cornflour onto a plate. Remove the chicken from the marinade and press each piece into the cornflour until fully coated.

While still hot, toss the cooked chicken with a mixture of salt, 1/2 tsp five spice powder, 1/2 tsp brown sugar, and 1/2 tsp white pepper. Serve immediately, optionally with crispy Thai basil or a chilli dipping sauce on the side.

steps: In a bowl, combine the tomato purée with 1/2 teaspoons of dried oregano, basil, and season with salt and pepper. Stir well and set aside for the flavors to meld.

In another mixing bowl, blend the self-raising flour with the Greek yogurt. Stir until a dough forms. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface, divide the dough in half, and shape each portion into a ball.

Using a floured rolling pin, roll out each dough ball into a round pizza base, dusting with more flour as needed to prevent sticking. Leave a slight edge thicker around the circumference for the crust.
Evenly spread the sauce over each pizza base, leaving the crust exposed. Distribute the pepperoni and cooked chicken evenly on top, then sprinkle with additional oregano and the cheese mix.

Set the air fryer to 190°C (374°F) and cook the pizzas for 12-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly and melted. Check halfway through and rotate the pizzas if necessary for even cooking.
Once cooked, remove the pizzas from the air fryer and let them cool slightly on a wire rack. Garnish with fresh basil leaves before serving for a fresh, herby flavor.

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees C or 350 degrees F.
Peel and chop the red onion and then fry it in a non-stick pan with 1/2 a tsp of olive oil, cooking for 2 to 3 minutes. Once cooked, set aside.

To a large mixing bowl, add the following: chicken mince, chili flakes, 1 tsp ground black pepper, panko breadcrumbs, rice flour, fresh coriander leaves (roughly chopped), garlic cloves (grated or crushed), juice of 1 lime, fresh ginger, fish sauce, an egg and finally the red onion.
Mix until well combined and then make 8 to 10 burger patties. Or if you would rather increase the size and cook less, do so.

Bring a large, non-stick frying pan to medium heat with 1/2 a tsp of olive oil. Cook each burger pattie for 1 minute on each side. If your pan is oven safe, toss it into the oven and cook for 12 to 15 minutes. If not, place the burgers on a roasting tray instead.
While the burgers cook, make the slaw. In a separate mixing bowl add the carrots (peeled and grated), the cabbage (use a peeler) and baby spinach.
Now make the dressing for the slaw by combining a tbsp of olive oil, the juice of 1 lime, a pinch of salt, and a few twists of black pepper.
Serve the burgers on a bed of slaw.

steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the diced white onion and minced garlic. Sauté until the onion is translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the paprika, ground cumin, and ground coriander, stirring to coat the onions and garlic with the spices. Cook for an additional minute until fragrant. Add the diced green peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes. Return the browned mince to the pot, mixing well with the onion and pepper mixture. Pour in the tinned whole tomatoes, breaking them up slightly with a spoon, and add the dark chocolate squares. Stir to combine. Add the beef stock and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook on low heat for 2-3 hours, stirring occasionally. If the sauce is too thin, add 1 tsp cornflour to thicken. After 1.5 hours, add the kidney beans and continue to simmer until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded.
In a bowl, combine the diced cherry tomatoes, a drizzle of olive oil, a pinch of salt, chopped coriander, and finely diced green chilli or jalapeno. Mix well and set aside.
Mash the avocado in a bowl, then mix in the diced chillli, minced garlic, chopped coriander, diced onion, and lime juice. Stir until well combined and season with salt to taste.
Spoon the Chilli Con Carne into bowls and top with a dollop of yogurt. Serve with the fresh salsa and guacamole on the side.

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Place the red peppers on a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for about 25-30 minutes or until the skin is charred and blistered. Once roasted, remove from the oven and set aside to cool.

While the peppers are roasting, prepare the chilli. In a pan, heat 1 teaspoon of olive oil over medium heat. Sauté 4 cloves of minced garlic and 1 medium brown onion until fragrant and translucent. Add 1 teaspoon of chipotle chilli paste, 1 teaspoon of ground oregano, 1 tablespoon of ground cumin, 1 teaspoon of brown sugar, and ½ tablespoon of ground cinnamon. Stir well to combine the spices. Add 500g of extra lean beef mince and cook until browned. Pour in 1 can of chopped tomatoes, 1 can of red kidney beans (drained), and 1 tablespoon of tomato puree. Reduce the heat and let it simmer for about 15-20 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld together.
Stuff each pepper with a generous amount of the prepared chilli mixture. You can return the stuffed peppers to the oven for an additional 10 minutes if you prefer them heated through.

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.

First make the turkey burgers. In a large pot/bowl, combine the turkey mince with 1 green chili (finely chopped), 3 cloves of garlic (crushed), a tsp of lazy ginger, rice flour, egg, and sesame seeds. Mix the ingredients well before adding the finely chopped coriander leaves, salt and pepper. Mix well again.

Once mixed, make 8 burger patties. To a pan, on medium heat, add a tsp of olive oil. Cook each burger for 2 minutes on either side before placing them on a roasting tray and cooking them in the oven for 10 to 12 minutes.

Next, make the slaw. To a large mixing bowl add 2 carrots (peeled and grated), the courgette (topped and grated), the red onion (peeled and finely sliced), peppers (deseeded and sliced), pak choy (sliced), and the spring onions (sliced).
Next, cook the rice noodles per packet instructions (typically leave them to soak in hot water for 8 minutes) and then rinse them in cold water until cooled before adding them to the veggie slaw.

steps: Cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions. Once cooked, drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process. Set aside.
Slice the chicken breasts into strips. In a mixing bowl, combine the chicken with 2 tsp ginger, 1 clove garlic, 2 tsp light soy sauce, 1 tsp of sesame oil, and 2 tsp Chinese five-spice.
Slice the red peppers, halve the baby corn, and chop the pak choy. Keep ready.
Lightly coat the marinated chicken strips in cornflour, shaking off any excess.
Heat 1/2 teaspoon of sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken strips and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until they start to brown.
Introduce the prepared vegetables to the wok. Cover with a lid to allow the vegetables to steam slightly, cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes.

Mix the ingredients for the stir-fry sauce in a small bowl (1 tbsp light soy sauce; 1 tsp fish sauce; 1 tsp honey; 1/2 tsp sesame oil; 1/2 tsp chilli flakes). Pour the sauce over the cooking vegetables and chicken, then add the precooked noodles. Toss everything together and cook until the noodles are heated through and have absorbed some of the sauce flavors.

steps: Finely dice all the vegetables and set aside. Heat your oven to 200°C/392°F fan.

Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Sauté the diced vegetables with a pinch of salt for 10 minutes until softened and slightly caramelised. Add the minced beef, breaking it up with a spoon. Cook on high heat for 10 minutes, adding the tomato puree, balsamic vinegar, and rosemary. Cook until the beef is browned. Pour in the passata and fill the passata tin with water, adding that to the pan. Stir in the stock, lentils, and seasoning. Simmer for 15-20 minutes, reducing the mixture until thickened.

In a separate pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 3 minutes, continuously stirring to avoid lumps. Gradually whisk in the milk, 200ml at a time, allowing the sauce to thicken before adding more. Stir in the cheddar cheese, stock cube, salt, and pepper. Let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes until it thickens slightly.

In a large baking dish, spread a layer of the ragu sauce, followed by spoonfuls of béchamel and a fine grating of Parmesan. Add a layer of lasagna sheets. Repeat this process for two more layers. Finish with a generous layer of béchamel sauce on top, a crack of black pepper, and the remaining Parmesan.
Cover the dish with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake for another 15 minutes until the top is golden and bubbling. Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before serving.

In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the oregano to the pan and stir it in the oil for about 30 seconds to release its flavor.
Add the sliced red peppers, onion, frozen peas, and mushrooms to the pan, sautéing them until the vegetables are tender.

recipes.description: This Pad Thai offers an explosion of flavors and textures that honor the dish's Thai roots while accommodating plant-based diets. Crispy tofu melds seamlessly with tender rice noodles, all drenched in a rich and tangy sauce that perfectly balances sweet, sour, and salty notes.

steps: Cut tofu into small cubes. Toss with corn starch, salt, and pepper. Heat some oil in a pan over medium heat, then fry the tofu until crispy and golden on all sides. Remove from heat and set aside.
Follow the instructions on the package to cook the rice noodles. Once cooked, drain, rinse in cold water and set aside.
In the same pan you used for the tofu, add a bit more oil if needed. Sauté the onion and grated garlic until the onion becomes translucent.
In a separate pan, scramble the egg. Set aside. For vegans, leave this step out.

In a bowl, whisk together lime juice, vegan fish sauce, brown sugar, rice wine vinegar, and soy sauce. Add the cooked tofu and scrambled vegan eggs back into the pan with the onion and garlic. Add in the rice noodles and the sauce. Stir well to combine.
Toss in the bean sprouts and chili flakes. Stir until the bean sprouts are slightly softened.
Divide the Pad Thai between two plates. Garnish with chopped scallions, a sprinkle of roasted peanuts, and a wedge of lime.
Serve with additional lime wedges and chili flakes if desired.

steps: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees

Chop the veg lengthways (thinly) like in the photo. Add them to a mixing bowl with a tsp of olive oil, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Mix well and transfer them to a tray. Roast at 180 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes.
As the veg is roasting, in a bowl add the smooth peanut butter, water, chopped chili, the juice of 1 lime, and two crushed garlic gloves. Mix well until you have a spoonable, smooth sauce.

Using a mallet or rolling pin, flatten the chicken breast. Then season with salt and pepper and the zest of a lime. With 15 minutes remaining before the veg is cooked, add the chicken to a hot pan with a tsp of olive oil. Cook evenly on each side. Turning every few minutes. With 5 minutes remaining, spoon the peanut sauce over the chicken and cook for 3 minutes.
With 2 minutes remaining, place the pan under the grill and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more. Serve the chicken on a bed of the roast veg.

Then add the chicken to the oven and continue to cook for another 10 to 12 minutes depending on the size of the breast.

Next, it is time to make the salad dressing. To a bowl add the following soy sauce (3 tablespoons), peanut butter (120g), sriracha (1 tablespoon), rice vinegar (2 tablespoons), lime juice (1 lime yield), maple syrup (1 tablespoon), ginger (1 tsp grated), garlic (1 clove crushed), water 2 tablespoons). This should make more than enough to last and use in other meals outside of these. It creates 6 portions.

Add 1/2 the salad dressing to the salad and mix well before transferring the salad to a bowl. Or you can add the salad to the bowl and then add 1/6 of the dressing on top. Once the chicken is cooked, add it to the top of the salad and finish with a pinch of sunflower seeds and white sesame seeds.

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Cook the rice according to the package instructions, then allow it to cool completely. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spread the cooked rice evenly. Toss the rice with 1 tbsp sesame oil and 20g teriyaki sauce until evenly coated. Bake for 30-35 minutes, tossing halfway through, until golden and crispy. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning.

Coat the 3 chicken breasts evenly with 20g teriyaki sauce. Place in the air fryer and cook at 180°C (360°F) for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. Remove from the air fryer and allow to cool slightly before slicing into bite-sized pieces.
Combine all the dressing ingredients in a blender or food processor. Blend for about 1 minute until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced cucumbers, red cabbage, cilantro, green onions, and red bell peppers. Add the shredded chicken and crispy rice on top of the vegetables. Drizzle the sesame ginger dressing over the salad. Toss well to combine.
Divide the salad into 4 portions and serve immediately. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

steps: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F).

In a large bowl, mix the ground chicken, breadcrumbs, chopped sun-dried tomatoes, feta, diced red onion, chopped mint, 2 minced garlic cloves, egg, milk, salt, and pepper until well combined. Roll the mixture into 12 evenly sized meatballs.

Heat a large non-stick over medium heat. Pan-sear the meatballs until golden brown on all sides (about 2–3 minutes per side). Transfer the meatballs to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until fully cooked through (internal temperature of 74°C/165°F).

In a small bowl, combine the Greek yogurt, 1 minced garlic coves, juice of 1 lemon, lemon zest, 1/2 tsp olive oil, 2 tbsp choped dill, salt, and pepper. Mix until smooth and refrigerate until ready to serve.

Cook the orzo in chicken stock according to package instructions. Drain and return to the pot. Stir in the spinach while the orzo is still warm, allowing it to wilt. Add olive oil, lemon juice, and crumbled feta, and mix well.
Plate the orzo and top with the cooked meatballs. Spoon the tzatziki sauce over the meatballs and garnish with extra dill or mint if desired. Serve warm with a lemon wedge on the side.

recipes.description: Dive into the flavors of this salad, a perfect blend of savory and sweet, with a hint of zest. This dish combines tender chicken breast and al dente pasta, complemented by the freshness of peas, red pepper, and a mix of basil and rocket. Topped with a creamy, tangy honey mustard dressing, it's a delightful meal for any day of the week.

steps: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper. In a skillet over medium heat, cook the chicken until golden and cooked through. Let it rest before slicing.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente. In the last 3 minutes of cooking, add the peas to the pasta water.
Dice the red peppers and half the green olives. Roughly chop the basil and rocket.
In a bowl, whisk together yogurt, wholegrain mustard, honey, chili flakes, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

Drain the pasta and peas, and transfer them to a large mixing bowl. Add the sliced chicken, red peppers, olives, basil, and rocket. Pour the honey mustard dressing over the pasta mixture and toss well to coat everything evenly.

It combines hearty ground beef with aromatic spices and veggies, topped with a spicy sriracha drizzle.

steps: Prepare the rice according to the package instructions. Once cooked, let it cool or rinse with cold water.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tsp of sesame oil over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks.
Once the beef is browned, add ginger, garlic, gochujang, soy sauce, honey, and a handful of brown sugar to the pan. Stir well to combine and let simmer for 2 minutes to meld the flavors.

Reduce the heat to medium. Add the cooked rice to the skillet, gently folding it in to incorporate fully without breaking the rice grains. Drizzle the remaining sesame oil over the rice and beef mixture.
Continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes, allowing the rice to absorb the flavors and get a slight crisp. Remove from heat.
Top with sliced spring onions and a generous drizzle of sriracha for added spice.

steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and cook for 5–7 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and mince, stirring to break up the meat. Cook for 7–8 minutes, or until browned. Stir in the tomato puree, mixed herbs, salt, and pepper. Add the Worcestershire sauce, beef stock and tinned tomatoes. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and let it cook for 15 minutes to deepen the flavors. Stir occasionally.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C (375°F). Chop the potatoes into chip slices. Place the chips in the air fryer basket and cook for 15 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy and golden.

Additionally, eating slowly and mindfully will help you sense fullness with more accuracy. Chew your food until it is a paste, take 15 seconds between each bite.

To a small bowl, add 2 garlic cloves (crushed), olive oil, rosemary, and salt. Mix well and then spoon over the potato. Add the roasting tray to the oven for 60 minutes.

Perfect for muscle recovery and energy replenishment, it’s served over steamed rice and topped with a crispy fried egg. A simple, flavorful meal in under 20 minutes!

Add the ground beef to the wok, breaking it apart as it cooks. Stir-fry for 3-5 minutes, until 80% cooked through. Pour in the soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce and sweetener. Stir well and cook for another 1-2 minutes, allowing the sauce to coat the beef evenly.
