steps: Slice the chorizo and place in a frying pan over medium heat. Cook until it turns golden, then remove it from the pan, draining excess fat on a paper towel.
In the same pan, sauté the sliced onion and chopped red pepper for about 10 minutes. Incorporate the sliced garlic and continue to cook for an additional minute.

Add the can of tomatoes to the pan, refilling half of the empty can with water and pouring it in as well. Follow this with the drained chickpeas, paprika, chilli flakes (if using), and houmous. Bring the mixture to a boil and then let it simmer for about 10 minutes until it thickens.
Adjust the seasoning to your liking. You might find a squeeze of lemon enhances the flavor by cutting through the richness of the chorizo. Finally, stir in the rocket and roughly chopped parsley.
Your Zesty Chorizo-Chickpea Stew is now ready to be savored! Enjoy this hearty, flavorful, and nutritious dish.

recipes.description: A satisfying blend of umami-rich mushrooms, tangy citrus, and a hint of chilli heat. These tacos are balanced by creamy avocado and the mild crunch of fresh red onion. A squeeze of lime brings out the vibrant flavors. Packed with plant-based protein and fibre, these tacos offer a nutritious and flavorful twist on a classic.

ingredients.note: Original reference: or 14.1 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Orange Juice

steps: Begin by shredding the king oyster mushrooms into thin strips using 2 forks. One to stabilize and one to strip.
Heat some olive oil in a pan and sauté the medium onion until it becomes translucent. Add a pinch of salt to the onions.
Stir in the 4 tsp of chilli and garlic paste, 2 tsp of oregano, 2 tbsp of soy sauce, juice from one orange, and 150ml of water. Mix well until everything is combined.
Add the shredded mushrooms to the pan, stirring to coat them thoroughly with the flavourful sauce.
Let the mixture simmer until it reduces down and the mushrooms are fully cooked.
Stir in the drained black beans and cook until they are heated through.
To assemble the tacos, spoon some of the mushroom and bean mixture onto each soft taco shell. Top with slices of red onion and avocado.
Serve the tacos with a lime wedge on the side for squeezing over just before eating.

recipes.description: Combining rich 70% dark chocolate, olive oil, and brown sugar, these brownies offer a fudgy texture and intense flavor. Almonds and walnuts add a delightful crunch, while Greek yogurt ensures moistness.

ingredients.name: 70% Dark Chocolate
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 3.5 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Flaked Almonds
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 3.5 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 3.5 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Walnuts
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 2.6 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Self Raising Flour
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 2.6 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Cocoa Powder
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Start by preheating your oven to 180°C (or 160°C for fan ovens, or gas mark 4). Prepare a 20cm (8in) square baking tin by lining it with baking parchment.

Break up the chocolate into small chunks and place them in a heatproof bowl. You can melt the chocolate by positioning the bowl over a pot of boiling water and stirring occasionally. Alternatively, microwave it on medium-low for 1–2 minutes, stirring after every 30-second interval to ensure even melting.

In a large bowl or mixer, combine olive oil, sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, almonds, baking powder, flour, cocoa powder, and yogurt. Mix these ingredients until they are well-blended to achieve a somewhat soft mixture. If the mixture is too thick, you can add a bit more yogurt or milk to loosen it.

Stir the melted chocolate and walnuts into the mixture. Spoon this batter into your prepared baking tin, making sure to level the surface. Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes. Check doneness with a skewer – it should come out clean when inserted into the center of the bake.
Once baked, let it cool in the tin for about 10 minutes. Then cut it into 12 even squares. For a touch of sweetness and presentation, sprinkle icing sugar on top, if desired. Enjoy!

recipes.description: This traditional Filipino sticky rice cake is an excellent source of rapidly digested carbohydrates, making it ideal before training to fuel performance or after a workout to help replenish muscle glycogen quickly. Its sweet coconut caramel topping delivers a quick energy boost, while the glutinous rice provides a steady release of glucose.

ingredients.name: Glutinous Rice
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 13.5oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Brown Sugar
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 8.8oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 4.2oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Soak the glutinous rice in cold water overnight. Drain and rinse before cooking.

Set aside 100ml / 3.5 fl oz) of coconut milk for the topping. In a large pot, bring 300ml coconut milk and 120ml water to a gentle boil. Add the soaked rice and simmer on medium heat for 6–8 minutes, stirring regularly.
Lower heat to medium-low. Stir in 150g (5.29oz) brown sugar and salt. Cook for 4–7 minutes, stirring until mixture is sticky and well combined.
Preheat oven to 180°C / 350°F. Spread rice mixture evenly into a greased or lined dish.
In a small saucepan, combine the remaining coconut milk and 100g (3.5oz) brown sugar. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until thickened. Let cool for 5 minutes and pour over the rice layer.
Bake at 180°C / 350°F for 60–65 minutes, until top is golden and slightly crisp. Let cool completely. Cut into squares or diamonds to serve.

recipes.description: Satisfy your sweet tooth while fueling your body with these Biscoff Protein Doughnuts. Made with oat flour and enriched with vanilla protein powder, these doughnuts offer a nutritious twist to a delightful treat. Topped with a silky Biscoff spread and crushed Lotus biscuits, they strike the perfect balance between indulgence and health.

ingredients.name: Almond Milk
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 3.4 fl oz, unsweetened. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Begin by preheating your oven to 180°C (356°F). To make oat flour, blend oats in a food processor or blender until they reach a fine, flour-like consistency. Transfer the oat flour to a mixing bowl.
Add the protein powder and baking powder to the bowl with the oat flour. Stir these dry ingredients together to ensure they are well combined.

Crack the egg into the mixture, and add the vanilla flavor drops (or sweetener) and unsweetened almond milk. Stir the mixture until smooth and well incorporated. Ensure there are no lumps in the batter.

Pour the batter evenly into the silicone doughnut mould tray, filling each mould about three-quarters full to allow room for the doughnuts to rise. Place the tray in the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the doughnuts are golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
While the doughnuts are baking, melt the Biscoff spread in a small bowl. Add boiling water to the biscoff, tsp by tsp until you reach the desired smooth and silky texture.

Once the doughnuts are baked and have cooled slightly, carefully remove them from the mould. Dip one side of each doughnut into the melted Biscoff spread, ensuring a thin layer covers the surface. Immediately sprinkle the crushed Lotus biscuits over the Biscoff spread on each doughnut for added crunch and flavor.

recipes.description: Craving something sweet but want to keep it healthier? These Blueberry Bliss Fritters are baked to perfection and lightly glazed for a delightful, guilt-free treat. With a burst of blueberries in every bite, they’re packed with protein from Greek yogurt and made without refined sugars. Ideal for breakfast, brunch, or a tasty snack!

ingredients.name: Plain Flour
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 3.5oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Greek Yoghurt
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 5.3oz, 0% fat. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Blueberries
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 2.6oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.

In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, sweetener, baking powder, and salt. Add the egg, melted butter, vanilla extract, and Greek yogurt. Stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix. Gently fold in the blueberries.
Using two teaspoons, scoop and drop small amounts of batter onto the prepared baking tray, forming 10-14 fritters.

Bake for 15 minutes, or until the fritters are golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean. While the fritters are baking, prepare the glaze. In a small bowl, mix together the powdered sweetener, smashed blueberries, vanilla extract, and almond milk until smooth.
Remove the fritters from the oven and brush each one with the blueberry glaze. Set the oven to broil and return the fritters to the oven for 5 minutes to caramelize the glaze.
Remove the fritters from the oven and drizzle any remaining glaze over the top for that perfect finish. Let cool slightly, then dig in and enjoy!

They offer a satisfying crunch and natural sweetness, making them a perfect post-workout snack or guilt-free dessert. Simple to prepare and irresistibly delicious, these bites are a healthy way to indulge your sweet tooth.

steps: In a bowl, combine the vanilla protein, desiccated coconut, and oats. Gradually add the almond milk to the mixture, stirring continuously. Mix until the ingredients come together to form a sticky mixture.
Using clean hands, shape the mixture into small, bite-sized balls. Place these on a plate or baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the bites to set.

While the bites are chilling, prepare the chocolate coating. Add 1/2 a tsp of coconut oil to a small pot and melt over low heat. Once the coconut oil is melted, add the dark chocolate to the pot and stir until it's fully melted and combined with the oil. Be careful to not let the chocolate burn.
Remove the bites from the refrigerator. One by one, dip each bite into the melted chocolate mixture, ensuring it's fully coated. Return the chocolate-coated bites to the plate or baking sheet.
Place the coated bites back into the refrigerator for an additional 15 minutes, or until the chocolate has completely set. Serve with a sprinkle of dedicated coconut.

steps: Start by finely chopping the dates and cashews, creating small, bite-sized pieces that will blend seamlessly into the mixture.
Next, combine all of the dry ingredients - the oats, grated carrot, chopped dates and cashews, chia seeds, and cinnamon - in a large mixing bowl. Stir them together until they're well-integrated.

Begin to slowly pour in the milk, stirring as you go. You're aiming for a consistency that's moist enough to hold together but not overly wet. If you find the mixture is still too dry, don't hesitate to add a bit more milk, pouring slowly until you reach the desired consistency.
Now comes the fun part. Using your hands, roll the mixture into small, bite-sized balls. This should be a relatively easy task if the mixture has the right balance of moisture.

Once you've rolled out all of your carrot cake bites, place them in the fridge to chill. This step will help them hold their shape and will also enhance their flavor. A little bit of waiting here will ensure you have a delicious, nutrient-dense snack ready to enjoy!

steps: Preheat your oven to 180°C (350°F).
Sift the self-raising flour into a mixing bowl. Add the Greek yogurt and stir until a dough forms. If the dough feels too sticky, add a touch more flour.

recipes.description: Indulge in creamy and nutty flavors with these Peanut Butter Protein Cups. Featuring a rich protein base and a sumptuous layer of peanut butter, all enrobed in silky chocolate, they offer a delightful texture and a burst of energy. These cups are a perfect post-workout snack or a healthy alternative to satisfy sweet cravings.

steps: In a bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt and vanilla whey protein powder until smooth.
Pour the protein mixture into silicone cup molds, filling them halfway. Tap the molds gently on the counter to remove any air bubbles.

Place the molds in the freezer for about 30 minutes, or until the protein mixture is firm. Once the protein base is set, sprinkle an even layer of the peanut butter mix (powder mixed with water) over each cup.

Return the molds to the freezer for an additional 20 minutes to set the peanut butter layer. Melt the chocolate chips with coconut oil in the microwave, using 20-second bursts and stirring in between until smooth.

Take the molds out of the freezer and pour the melted chocolate over the peanut butter layer, filling the molds to the top. Place the molds back into the freezer for a final 10 minutes, or until the chocolate has completely hardened.
Gently pop the protein cups out of the molds. They're ready to eat or can be stored in the freezer in an airtight container.

recipes.description: A protein-packed twist on your classic bagel recipe. Blending cottage cheese into the dough adds a smooth texture and boosts the protein content, making them perfect for a healthy and satisfying breakfast or snack. With minimal ingredients, they’re easy to make and are a nutritious option to fuel your day.

steps: Set your oven to 180°C (350°F) to preheat while you prepare the dough.

In a large bowl, combine the self-raising flour, baking powder, salt, and blended cottage cheese. Stir until a dough begins to form. If the dough feels too dry, gradually add warm water, a little at a time, until the dough comes together.
Transfer the dough to a floured surface and knead it for a few minutes until smooth and elastic.

Roll the dough into a ball and cut it into 4 equal parts. Take each quarter and roll it into a ball. Use your fingers to make a hole in the center of each ball, gently pulling the dough apart to create a bagel shape.
Place the bagels on a prepared baking tray lined with parchment paper. Brush the top of each bagel with the beaten egg and sprinkle sesame seeds (or your favorite toppings) over the top.
Bake the bagels in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until they are golden brown and firm on the outside.

recipes.description: This microwave honeycomb is a fun and fast treat made with just three ingredients. Crunchy, golden, and lightly caramelised with a bubbly texture, it’s perfect on its own or crumbled over desserts like ice cream or yoghurt. Perfect for adding some extra carbs on training days.

ingredients.note: Original reference: or 3.5oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1.7fl oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Line a bowl or small tray with baking paper, ensuring it’s ready before you start – the mixture sets fast.
Combine the sugar and water in a large microwave-safe bowl. Stir well to dissolve the sugar.
Microwave in 30-second bursts, watching closely. It should take around 2–3 minutes total for the mixture to bubble and turn a deep golden orange. (Be cautious – it gets very hot.)
Remove from the microwave and let it sit for 30 seconds. Then quickly stir in the bicarbonate of soda. The mixture will foam up instantly – do not overmix. Let it naturally settle and rise.
Cool in the fridge for 10–15 minutes or until completely set and crisp. Break into chunks and enjoy!

recipes.description: Packed with fiber and natural sweetness, these Raspberry Chia Oat Bars are the perfect balance of chewy, fruity, and nutty flavors. With the added benefit of homemade chia jam, they’re a wholesome snack option that keeps you fueled throughout the day. These bars are nutrient-dense, portable, and easy to make!

ingredients.note: Original reference: or 7oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Banana
ingredients.note: large

steps: Add the frozen raspberries to a saucepan and simmer over medium heat until they defrost and release their juices. Stir in the chia seeds and vanilla extract, mixing well. If desired, add honey or sugar to taste. Allow the jam to cool and thicken as the chia seeds absorb the liquid. Set aside.

In a large mixing bowl, mash the ripe banana until smooth. Mix in the vanilla extract, peanut butter, sweetener, baking powder, salt, and milk. Gradually fold in the rolled oats to form a sticky batter.

Preheat the oven to 170°C (fan) or air fryer to 160°C. Line a baking tin with parchment paper or use a non-stick baking dish (a 19cm skillet works well). Press just over half of the oat mixture into the base of the tin, ensuring it’s evenly spread. Spoon the raspberry chia jam over the base layer, spreading it evenly. Crumble the remaining oat mixture over the jam layer, pressing gently to form clusters.
Place the assembled bars in the oven and bake for 20 minutes or air fry at 160°C for the same duration. Bake until the top is golden.
Allow the bars to cool completely in the tin. This ensures they firm up for slicing. Once cooled, cut into 6 bars. Serve with an optional dollop of greek yoghurt

recipes.description: Delight in these nutritious yet indulgent cupcakes, blending the creamy richness of SKYR yogurt with the sweetness of fresh strawberries. Crafted with oats, whey protein, and flaked almonds, and brightened with a hint of lemon zest, these cupcakes are a perfect choice for a healthier dessert or a splendid treat at any time of the day.

ingredients.name: Skyr Yoghurt
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 16oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Porridge Oats
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 4.2oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.note: Original reference: or 2oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Start by preheating your oven to 180°C (356°F). Prepare your muffin tins or cupcake molds.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the SKYR yogurt, eggs, vanilla extract, caster sugar, lemon zest, and olive oil. Whisk until the mixture is smooth. Fold in the bicarbonate of soda and baking powder, then gradually mix in the oats, whey protein, plain flour, and flaked almonds. Stir just until the batter comes together to avoid overmixing.
Distribute the batter evenly among the prepared muffin tins or cupcake molds, filling each about three-quarters full.
Sprinkle the diced strawberries over the batter of each cupcake. The strawberries will slightly sink into the batter as it bakes, adding moisture and flavor.

Bake in the preheated oven for 15-18 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a cupcake comes out clean. If the cupcakes start to brown too quickly on top, cover them loosely with foil to prevent burning.

Let the cupcakes cool in the pan for 15 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. Enjoy the cupcakes as they are, or garnish with additional yogurt, fresh strawberries, or a light dusting of powdered sugar if desired.

recipes.description: Experience the rich, tangy, and aromatic flavors of these stuffed flatbreads. Made from a simple Greek yogurt and self-raising flour dough, they're filled with a delectable mix of sun-dried tomatoes, fresh basil, and cheeses. Pan-cooked for a crisp finish and then air-fried for perfection, these flatbreads are a delightful twist on traditional fare.

ingredients.note: Original reference: or 7 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Greek Yogurt

steps: In a mixing bowl, combine 200g/7oz self-raising flour with 170g/6oz Greek yogurt. Mix until it forms a soft dough. If the dough is too sticky, add a bit more flour until the right consistency is reached. Divide the dough into equal portions and set aside.

In a separate bowl, finely chop the sun-dried tomatoes and mix them with chopped basil. Add 80g 0% fat Greek yogurt, 50g light mozzarella, and 50g light feta to the bowl. Mix well to combine. Season the stuffing mixture with a pinch of salt.

Take each portion of dough and roll it into a flat circle. Place a generous amount of the stuffing mixture in the center. Fold the dough over the stuffing to create a semi-circle, sealing the edges well.
Heat a pan over low heat. Once hot, place each stuffed flatbread on the pan. Cook for 3-5 minutes on each side or until golden brown and slightly crispy.
After pan-cooking, transfer the flatbreads to an air fryer. Set the temperature to 200°C and cook for 3 minutes until they have a crispy exterior.

steps: Microwave the bag of wild rice according to the instructions on the package. Typically 2 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together. Thinly slice the spring onion and set it aside. Grate half a carrot and set it aside.
Heat a non-stick frying pan or wok over medium-high heat and add the sesame oil. Once hot, pour the beaten eggs into the pan and stir them gently until they are cooked through and scrambled.

recipes.description: Indulge in the warmth and sweetness of these homemade cinnamon rolls, made with ripe bananas for a moist and tender dough. Brushed with melted butter, sprinkled with cinnamon and brown sugar, and finished with a simple icing sugar glaze, these cinnamon rolls are a delightful sweet treat.

ingredients.name: Self-Raising Flour
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 5.6 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: spreadable Butter
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1 oz, 60% fat. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Begin by preheating your oven to 180°C (350°F). Prepare a baking tray by lining it with parchment paper.

In a medium-sized bowl, mash the bananas thoroughly using a fork. Add in the self-raising flour and mix until a dough forms. If the dough feels too sticky, gradually add a bit more flour until it becomes manageable, but be cautious not to add too much.

Dust a clean surface lightly with flour and roll out the dough into a rectangle approximately 1 centimeter thick. Using a pastry brush, spread the melted butter evenly over the surface of the dough. Sprinkle the cinnamon and brown sugar uniformly over the buttered dough.

Cut the dough rectangle into 7-8 equal strips. Carefully roll each strip into a roll and place them on the prepared baking tray. If you prefer the rolls to be touching and stick together, arrange them accordingly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges of the rolls begin to turn a golden brown. Once baked, remove the cinnamon rolls from the oven and allow them to cool a wire rack.

While the rolls are cooling, prepare the glaze. In a small bowl, mix the sugar with 1-2 tablespoons of water, adjusting the amount of water as needed to achieve your desired consistency for the glaze. Drizzle the glaze over the slightly cooled cinnamon rolls.

recipes.description: A deeply caramelized, sweet, and savory roasted butternut squash, infused with butter, pure maple syrup, cinnamon, and fresh thyme. This simple yet flavorful dish is rich in fiber, vitamin A, and antioxidants, making it a perfect side for cozy meals or holiday spreads.

ingredients.name: Butternut Squash
ingredients.note: large

steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Cut the butternut squash in half lengthwise and scoop out the seeds. Drizzle ½ tsp olive oil over each half and sprinkle with flaky salt.
Place ½ tsp butter in the center of each squash half. Drizzle 1 tsp maple syrup in the center of each squash half. Sprinkle cinnamon and fresh thyme generously over the squash.

Place the squash halves cut-side up in a baking dish. Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 60 minutes. Once tender and caramelized, remove from the oven. Sprinkle with extra flaky salt for balance. Serve warm as a side dish or mash it up for a delicious spread!

recipes.description: Seasoned with bold spices and roasted to perfection, these chickpeas offer a satisfying crunch, while the light feta and Greek yogurt blend into a smooth, tangy backdrop, brightened with a hint of lemon. A perfect appetizer, snack, or light meal for any occasion!

steps: Preheat your oven to 200°C (392°F). In a large bowl, combine the chickpeas with 2 tablespoons of olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, dried oregano, chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Mix well until the chickpeas are evenly coated with the spices and oil.

Spread the seasoned chickpeas on a roasting tray in a single layer. Place in the preheated oven and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until they are crispy on the outside and still soft on the inside. Shake the tray halfway through for even cooking.

While the chickpeas are roasting, add the feta cheese, Greek yogurt, minced garlic, and lemon zest to a food processor. Blend until the mixture is very smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding more salt if needed.
Spread the whipped feta dip smoothly onto a serving plate. Once the chickpeas are done, spoon them over the dip. Garnish with additional lemon zest and an optional drizzle of olive oil.
Serve immediately while the chickpeas are warm and crispy, paired with pita bread, vegetable sticks, or enjoy as is for a delightful Mediterranean-inspired treat.

steps: Choose a microwave-safe mug large enough to contain the rising cake. Alternatively, use smaller silicon cupcake moulds.

In the mug, mash the half banana until it forms a puree. Add protein powder, oat flour, cocoa powder, sweetener, baking powder, and salt. Mix well until all the dry ingredients are well incorporated with the mashed banana.
Pour the milk into the mug. Stir until the batter is smooth and free from lumps. Make sure to mix well to combine the milk with the dry ingredients.

Place the mug in the microwave. Cook on high for approximately 1-2 minutes. The cooking time may vary depending on the microwave's power. The cake is done when it has risen and is set in the middle.
Carefully remove the mug from the microwave (it will be hot). Allow the cake to cool for a minute or two before serving.

Once you achieve this texture (you may need to add another bit of flour depending on the yogurt used), spread and flatten the dough to the desired pizza size.
Place the pan in the oven at 180 degrees Celcius / 350 Fahrenheit for 12 to 15 minutes.

As the base is being cooked, cook the pizza sauce. To a pot add 1/2 tin of chopped tomatoes, tsp of basil, tsp of oregano and the remaining garlic cloves. Cook on medium-high heat until the sauce reduces. This should take around the same time as the pizza base.

recipes.description: These umami-packed soy-marinated eggs are rich in protein and deeply flavorful, making them the perfect addition to ramen, rice bowls, or a quick high-protein snack. Marinated overnight in soy sauce, fish sauce, maple syrup, and aromatics, these eggs develop an irresistibly savory-sweet taste.

ingredients.name: Cottage Cheese
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 7oz, fat free. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Bring a pot of water to a gentle boil. Carefully lower 2-4 eggs into the water and boil for 6-7 minutes for jammy yolks. Immediately transfer to an ice bath and let cool for 5 minutes before peeling.
In a shallow container with a lid, whisk together soy sauce, fish sauce, maple syrup/honey, toasted sesame seeds, chopped chili, green onions, and crushed garlic.
Submerge the peeled eggs in the marinade, ensuring they are fully coated. Cover and refrigerate overnight (8+ hours) for maximum flavor.

Remove the eggs from the marinade and slice in half before serving. Enjoy as a protein-rich snack, with cottage cheese, or as a topping for ramen, fried rice, or avocado toast. The eggs can be stored in the marinade for up to 3 days—the longer they sit, the stronger the flavor!

Add the zero-calorie sweetener, corn flour, and vanilla extract to the cream cheese. Mix everything until well incorporated and smooth.
Gently fold in the vanilla yogurt into the mixture, ensuring it's just combined to maintain a light consistency.
Crack one egg into the mixture. Stir it in gently until the mixture is free of clumps and has a uniform consistency.

Add the lemon juice, turmeric, ginger, pineapple juice, and black pepper to a blender. Blend the mixture on high until everything is well combined and you achieve a smooth consistency.

Transfer the liquid to a bottle or container. It's best consumed fresh, but you can refrigerate and shake well before drinking.

steps: In a bowl, combine the oats, chia seeds, a pinch of salt, and vanilla extract. Pour in the almond milk, stirring well to ensure all ingredients meld together.
Cover the mixture and place it in the refrigerator to soak overnight, allowing the oats and chia seeds to swell and absorb the flavors.

Infused with aromatic herbs and a hint of chilli, these fritters make for a fantastic appetizer or a light meal. Goes well paired with creamy hummus and soy yogurt.

steps: Begin by grating the asparagus, carrots, and potatoes. Once grated, transfer them to a clean kitchen towel.
Gather the edges of the towel to form a pouch and squeeze out as much liquid as you can from the grated vegetables. This step is crucial as it ensures your fritters won't be soggy.

Transfer the squeezed vegetables to a large mixing bowl. Add in the diced onion, chopped chilli, dill, parsley, salt, and flour. Mix well. Gradually add water, stirring continuously to form a thick but moist batter.

In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Once hot, scoop spoonfuls of the batter into the skillet, flattening them into disc shapes. Fry each fritter for about 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until they are golden brown.
Transfer the fried fritters to an air fryer. Set the temperature to 200°C (392°F) and air-fry the fritters until they turn extra crispy, about 7-10 minutes.
Once done, place the fritters on a serving plate. Serve each fritter with a teaspoon of hummus and a dollop of soy yogurt on the side. Garnish with a sprinkle of dill or parsley if desired.

steps: Drain the canned black beans and defrost the sweet corn. Dice the red pepper, deseed and finely chop the red chili, and chop the fresh coriander leaves.

In a large pot, combine the drained black beans, sweet corn, red pepper, and chopped red chili. Stir in the ground cumin, paprika, lime juice and oregano, ensuring everything is well mixed. Cook this mixture over medium heat for about 3-5 minutes until the flavors meld together and the vegetables soften slightly.

While the mixture is cooking, heat your plain wheat tortillas in a separate pan over medium heat until they are warm and slightly toasty. This should only take a few minutes. Be sure to flip them halfway through for even warming.

Once the tortillas are heated, spoon the black bean and vegetable mixture onto one half of each tortilla. Sprinkle the cheese on top of the mixture, then fold the other half of the tortilla over to create a half-moon shape.
Continue to heat each filled quesadilla in the pan, flipping once, until the tortilla is golden brown and the cheese is melted.

steps: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees and gather all of the ingredients for easy access.

Next prepare the falafel mix by adding the following to a blender: a can of drained chickpeas, 1 red onion (quartered), 2 garlic cloves, 1 spring onion, a bunch of parsley (15g), a bunch of coriander (15g), a bunch of dill (15g), 1 tablespoon of cumin, 1 teaspoon of cayenne pepper, 1/2 a teaspoon of baking powder and 1/2 a teaspoon of ground black pepper
Blend until a thick smooth texture develops. Next transfer the mixture to a baking tray by making 6 falafel patties. Add them to the oven for 24 to 30 minutes, turning halfway.

As the falafel cooks, begin making the slaw. To make the slaw, chop the cabbage, peel and grate the carrot and chop the parsley. Add these to a large salad bowl along with a crushed garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon, 1/2 a tablespoon of cumin, and a pinch of salt. Mix well.

To each bowl, add a handful of rocket and spinach as a base. Then add a third of the slaw mixture, a third of an avocado (sliced), and a tablespoon of beetroot hummus. Once the falafels are ready serve on top of the vegetable mixture and finish off by topping with a pinch of sunflower seeds and a tablespoon of pomegranate jewels.

steps: First, make the guac. To a bowl add 1/2 a red onion (chopped), 1 red chili (deseeded & chopped), 1 avocado (cored and mashed), 1 tsp of coriander (chopped), the juice of 1 lime, 1 plum tomato (chopped). Mix the ingredients well.
Next to a pan on low-medium heat add 1 tsp of olive oil, the other 1/2 of the red onion (chopped), 3 garlic cloves (crushed), and red pepper (deseeded and chopped). Cook for 3 minutes.

Add the spice mixture and then add the beans (drained and rinsed). Cook for another 3 to 5 minutes. Remove the bean mixture and add them to a bowl. Set the bowl to the side and clean the pan to be used immediately again.

Place a wrap on the pan (without oil), on low-medium heat. To one half of the wrap, layer in the bean mixture, 20 grams of cheese, and a tablespoon of guac. Cook for 2-4 minutes before closing over the wrap.
Remove the wrap and cut it in half. Repeat the process from step 5 to make the second portion.

Alternatively, you can add a wrap to the pan and cook it for 3 minutes. Then remove it and add another wrap. Cover it with the entire bean mixture, and 2 tablespoons of guac. Add the precooked wrap on top and then simply cut into quarters when you remove it (this can be a little messy).

steps: Preheat your oven. Toss the chopped sweet potato with a drizzle of olive oil, paprika, cumin, and cinnamon. Lay them out on a baking tray and roast until they are tender and slightly caramelized.

In a pan, heat some olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. Add in the same seasonings you used for the sweet potatoes and stir. Add the black beans and cook until they're warmed through.

recipes.description: These bite-sized delights are packed with wholesome oats, crunchy cashews, and fiber-rich chia seeds. They contain grated carrot which adds a natural sweetness and is rich in antioxidants. Dates and a touch of honey offer additional sweetness without the need for refined sugars.

ingredients.name: Oats
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 9/10 cups. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

ingredients.name: Dates
ingredients.note: Original reference: or 1.7 oz. Scaling uses the leading printed amount.

steps: Start by finely chopping the dates and cashews, creating small, bite-sized pieces that will blend seamlessly into the mixture.
Next, combine all of the dry ingredients - the oats, grated carrot, chopped dates and cashews, chia seeds, and cinnamon - in a large mixing bowl. Stir them together until they're well-integrated.

Begin to slowly pour in the milk, stirring as you go. You're aiming for a consistency that's moist enough to hold together but not overly wet. If you find the mixture is still too dry, don't hesitate to add a bit more milk, pouring slowly until you reach the desired consistency.
Now comes the fun part. Using your hands, roll the mixture into small, bite-sized balls. This should be a relatively easy task if the mixture has the right balance of moisture.

Once you've rolled out all of your carrot cake bites, place them in the fridge to chill. This step will help them hold their shape and will also enhance their flavor. A little bit of waiting here will ensure you have a delicious, nutrient-dense snack ready to enjoy!
